Diagnosis.submission: The root cause is a dangling admission webhook "pod-policy.validation.k8s.io" (failurePolicy: Fail) that matches all pod CREATE operations in namespace hotel-reservation, but its backing service "pod-policy-webhook" in namespace "policy-system" does not exist (the policy-system namespace itself is absent). The recommendation pod recommendation-6bf7689fdb-fmhf7 was terminated at 18:17:43, right after this webhook was created at 18:17:41. Since then, ReplicaSet recommendation-6bf7689fdb fails with ReplicaFailure/FailedCreate: failed calling webhook pod-policy.validation.k8s.io - service pod-policy-webhook not found - so deployment/recommendation cannot recreate its pod. As a result, the recommendation deployment shows 0/1 available replicas and the recommendation service has no endpoints while all other services have endpoints. The recommendation pod being gone also leaves a stale Consul registration (10.244.162.169) for srv-recommendation, which the frontend uses for gRPC load-balancing, so recommendation operations through the frontend fail. Impact: recommendation functionality in the hotel-reservation app is broken and cannot self-heal while the dangling webhook exists. Faulty component: the pod-policy.validation.k8s.io ValidatingWebhookConfiguration blocking pod creation in the hotel-reservation namespace.
